 .;updating the STATUS and COMMENTS fields of the HEALTH FACTORS
 .;file (#393).

b52c12e9: ;If there is data in the MSG node, store the COMMENTS in DE(8)

82049c0c: ;Output the field data, wrapping lines longer than 45 characters
8acf5bd8: ;If the data is longer than 19 characters and the WORD-WRAPPING or FIELD CODES properties are set, branch to get word-wrapping
13cebad3: If the field is not editable and is for input only, display '(No Editing)'.
bbbe156d: Read user input, set timeout, and handle timeout with beep.
a96315bc: Exit the input routine.
34d82ecd: Increment the question order counter.
0a1d913b: Go to the next question based on the question order counter.
565ebe56: If the DIRQUIT flag is set, terminate input and return null.
d9d32b98: Store the final user input value.
a198e806: If input is a '?', display the field description.
c730ec74: Set the internal entry number in the UTILITY global for a new entry being added.
9c0634be: Set up the DIR user input читать() variables.
ce2a793f: Initialize DDER to prevent the initial value of X from going through the input transform or DIEQ cross references.
8519a979: Exit the field.
20476554: If the data value is a pointer, set DIC to the file being pointed to and call ^DIC to look up and return the .01 field value.
e4f4e0d2: If the data value is numeric and exceeds the maximum length of 24 characters, kill it.
508c2df7: If the data value contains only numeric characters with leading +/- and a decimal point, convert it to a number.
9b338806: Execute the INPUT transform for the field.
7c49d66d: Store the new value of X in ^UTILITY, and in the DIEFIRE global for auditing purposes.
64dda479: Sound the terminal alarm and go to the input reader if input is not valid.
b6ae9a1d: Set X to '?BAD' to make DIE more conservative about what it considers a valid response.
8fc9188c: If the user entered a question mark, let the DIEQ routine handle it.
4bd6c8cd: Sets up DQ array with details needed by DIR utilities.
3019797b: If DE(DQ) (data array) is undefined, call output transform and read input. If DV doesn't allow nulls and input is null, re-prompt. If input is @ and DV allows nulls, accept @.
356c931c: If DG (global ref) is passed, save it in DG, get value from DE(DQ) array and executable input transform.
1380195e: If DG is P (pointer) and global root is defined, get ien from 0 node and stuff into X. If global doesn't exist, reset Y and X.
f34a68c8: If DG is V (variable pointer) and ien exists, get value from global, else reset Y and get .01 field spec. If no .01 field, reset DG and X.
6d158565: If DG is D (computed) call UTILITY, else if DG is S (set/kill) get value from X using ';' delim.
d6328580: Call output transform on X. If input is null and not required, accept it. If required and DC<2, show reset prompt.
25696714: If DV is not I (input transform) or # (help msg), branch to read input.
21acf674: Execute input transform and re-prompt if it returns a value.
ac689191: End of code.
